outcome: Settle the three places where the two adapters give different answers to the same question, so that a green test on the fast adapter is evidence about the slow one for the answer and not only for the cost.
non_goals: Do not decide by preference which adapter is right; measure what the real one does and say so
Do not change an adapter's answer without a test that fails first on the old one
Do not close the gap by deleting the assertion that exposes it
